summary: Iter30: Verified removal of admin verification for students and new biodata-completion flow. Backend: /api/auth/register now returns status=approved and student endpoints are instantly accessible (no 403). Startup migration moves all pre-existing status=pending students to approved. Proctor and tutor registrations still return status=pending. Frontend: a student lacking school_id or grade is redirected to /lengkapi-biodata after login; submitting without school or without agreement checkbox shows error toasts; valid submit via PUT /api/auth/profile persists data and navigates to /student; refresh no longer redirects; /lengkapi-biodata redirects completed students to /student; admin is never redirected to biodata; newly registered proctor still goes to /pending. All 8 backend pytest cases and 7 UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Register.js still contains dead-code branch `if (data.status && data.status !== 'approved') navigate('/pending')` for student register which can now never fire since backend forces approved; safe to clean up but not harmful.
needsBiodata() in AuthContext relies on both school_id AND grade; Google-registered users (school_id=None) are handled, and password-registered users always provide both at /register — correct.
seed_data_creation: Reset siswa@lms.id.grade=None in Mongo prior to UI test to trigger biodata redirect; test re-filled it to '12 IPA'. Created ephemeral TEST_ users via register endpoints. No cleanup script run (test prefix only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_biodata.py cover register-status, migration, profile-update persistence and all four role logins. The siswa@lms.id user's grade is left as '12 IPA TEST' after tests; if next tester needs biodata redirect, reset grade to None.
